question: For each VM state (restricted to instances that have a system metadata entry with KEY = 'image_image_type' and are running on host 'blaze8-12'), show the VM state, the average/range/variance of ROOT_GB, and also include the overall average of the per-VM-state average ROOT_GB across all VM states in this filtered set.   SELECT DISTINCT i.vm_state, i.root_gb
  FROM instances i
  JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type'
    AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'
),
state_stats AS (
  SELECT vm_state,
         AVG(root_gb) AS avg_root_gb,
         MAX(root_gb) - MIN(root_gb) AS range_root_gb,
         VARIANCE(root_gb) AS var_root_gb
  FROM base
  GROUP BY vm_state
)
SELECT vm_state, avg_root_gb, range_root_gb, var_root_gb,
       AVG(avg_root_gb) OVER () AS overall_avg_of_state_avgs
FROM state_stats
